summary.text: Don Lippert is the Democratic candidate for the North Dakota House of Representatives, District 45, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He says his campaign is focused on affordable childcare and on making teaching a more financially viable profession.

paragraphs.text: Don Lippert attended Fargo North High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Minnesota State University Moorhead in 2015.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is originally from a farm outside Tolna, North Dakota, has lived most of his life in north Fargo, and holds a degree in Social Studies Education but did not pursue a teaching career for financial reasons.
He said he has worked as an employee and manager in a variety of industries and that he wants to improve the efficiency of state government programs.
Lippert advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
He said he is focused on finding solutions to the lack of affordable childcare in North Dakota, which he described as a problem for families and for the business community.
